config.expected_if_false: In at least one seed the N=128 force margin is within 0.02 of, or above, the same seed's N=64 data_seed 1 value. That would mean the N=64-to-N=128 force drop does not generalise across datasets.
config.expected_if_true: In both seeds, the N=128 final best-layer force margin is in [0.06, 0.20] and at least 0.04 below the same seed's N=64 data_seed 1 value, and the normalised accel_step margin is in [0.60, 0.78].
config.hypothesis: Force decodability declines gradually with steps_per_orbit from N=64 to N=128 on any dataset, not just data_seed 0 (where N=128 gave 0.094-0.150 against N=64's 0.215-0.261). On data_seed 1, with seeds 20-21 and every other setting matched to the paired N=64 data_seed 1 arm (4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], m2 in [0.1, 1], 3000 steps, best-of-3 controls), the N=128 force margin is clearly below the same seed's N=64 value, and the normalised accel_step margin is unchanged. Paired differences are computed per seed from both arms' run-record trajectories. If either arm's per-seed trajectory is unavailable, the comparison is reported as not computed.
